    {
      "chapter_id": 1,
      "title": "0% Accuracy, 100% Luck",
      "goal": "Survive the Isekai tutorial by exploiting a glitch in the 'Luck' stat that guarantees critical hits on missed attacks.",
      "chapter_role": "hook",
      "stakes_shift": "From a confused casualty to a high-variance glass cannon with a target on his back.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Protagonist dies in a mundane accident and wakes up in the System's arrival lounge.",
        "to_next": "The protagonist realizes his 'broken' build requires specific gear to be viable outside the tutorial zone."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 4,
        "tempo": "steady",
        "expected_scene_count": 10
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Welcome to the Lobby",
          "intent": "Introduce the protagonist's death and the absurdity of the System's arrival lounge.",
          "end_condition": "Protagonist reaches the tutorial kiosk and receives his initial stat allocation.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie wakes up in the Arrival Lounge, confused by the floating UI and the lack of a pulse.",
              "type": "exposition",
              "outcome": "Artie accepts his death and the reality of the System.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Arrival Lounge",
              "location_end_label": "Arrival Lounge",
              "location_start": "LOC_ARRIVAL_LOUNGE",
              "location_end": "LOC_ARRIVAL_LOUNGE",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie opens his eyes to find himself floating in a void of white light.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["white light", "floating sensation", "void hum"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:2",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie walks toward the nearest reception desk.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["reception desk", "marble floor", "floating pens"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Artie argues with The Clerk about the 'unfortunate piano accident' that killed him.",
              "type": "dialogue",
              "outcome": "The Clerk fast-tracks Artie to the stat kiosk to clear the queue.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01", "Bureaucrat_01"],
              "introduces": ["Bureaucrat_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Arrival Lounge",
              "location_end_label": "Arrival Lounge",
              "location_start": "LOC_ARRIVAL_LOUNGE",
              "location_end": "LOC_ARRIVAL_LOUNGE",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The Clerk taps a stack of holographic papers on the reception desk.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["holographic papers", "clacking keys", "bureaucratic sigh"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:1",
              "hands_off_to": "1:3",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie is shoved toward a glowing terminal at the end of the hall.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["glowing terminal", "hallway lights", "shuffling feet"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Artie attempts to distribute his points but the kiosk glitches, dumping everything into Luck.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie receives his initial stat allocation: 0 Accuracy, 99 Luck.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Arrival Lounge",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Kiosk",
              "location_start": "LOC_ARRIVAL_LOUNGE",
              "location_end": "LOC_TUTORIAL_KIOSK",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie places his hand on the glass surface of the Tutorial Kiosk.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["glass surface", "stat screen", "glitching pixels"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",
              "hands_off_to": "1:4",
              "transition_out_text": "The kiosk emits a loud chime as the stat allocation locks in.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["loud chime", "locking mechanism", "stat confirmation"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Protagonist reaches the tutorial kiosk and receives his initial stat allocation."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Glitch in the Machine",
          "intent": "Establish the 'Luck' stat exploit through experimentation on tutorial dummies.",
          "end_condition": "Protagonist successfully triggers a guaranteed 'Miss-Crit' on a practice dummy.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Artie enters the Training Yard and attempts to hit a practice dummy with a wooden sword.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie misses every swing, feeling completely useless.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Kiosk",
              "location_end_label": "Training Yard",
              "location_start": "LOC_TUTORIAL_KIOSK",
              "location_end": "LOC_TRAINING_YARD",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie steps out onto the dusty ground of the Training Yard.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["dusty ground", "wooden sword", "practice dummies"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:3",
              "hands_off_to": "1:5",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie swings the sword, only to watch it sail inches past the dummy's head.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["whistling air", "clumsy swing", "missed target"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "A stray swing misses the dummy so badly it triggers a massive shockwave.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "The dummy is obliterated by a 'Critical Miss' shockwave.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01"],
              "threads": ["thread_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Training Yard",
              "location_end_label": "Training Yard",
              "location_start": "LOC_TRAINING_YARD",
              "location_end": "LOC_TRAINING_YARD",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie loses his grip on the sword, causing it to spin wildly into the air.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["spinning sword", "air friction", "sudden silence"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",
              "hands_off_to": "1:6",
              "transition_out_text": "A massive explosion of light erupts where the sword didn't land.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["explosion of light", "shattered wood", "ringing ears"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Artie checks his combat logs and realizes his high Luck is forcing the System to calculate 'Missed' damage as 'Critical'.",
              "type": "exposition",
              "outcome": "Artie understands the mechanics of the Miss-Crit glitch.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01"],
              "threads": ["thread_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Training Yard",
              "location_end_label": "Training Yard",
              "location_start": "LOC_TRAINING_YARD",
              "location_end": "LOC_TRAINING_YARD",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie pulls up the translucent combat log in front of his face.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["translucent log", "scrolling text", "damage numbers"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "hands_off_to": "1:7",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie grins as the math finally starts to make a twisted kind of sense.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["twisted math", "realization grin", "system logic"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "Artie practices his 'Miss-Crit' technique, intentionally aiming away from targets to destroy them.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie successfully triggers a guaranteed 'Miss-Crit' on a practice dummy.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01"],
              "threads": ["thread_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Training Yard",
              "location_end_label": "Training Yard",
              "location_start": "LOC_TRAINING_YARD",
              "location_end": "LOC_TRAINING_YARD",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie takes a wide stance and aims three feet to the left of the next dummy.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["wide stance", "leftward aim", "deliberate miss"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "hands_off_to": "1:8",
              "transition_out_text": "The dummy vaporizes as the System registers a 10,000% damage multiplier.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["vaporized wood", "damage multiplier", "system chime"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Protagonist successfully triggers a guaranteed 'Miss-Crit' on a practice dummy."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Tutorial Boss Logic",
          "intent": "Demonstrate the build's viability in a low-stakes boss encounter.",
          "end_condition": "The tutorial boss is defeated via the 'Miss-Crit' exploit, granting passage to the world.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "Artie enters the Boss Arena, where the Slime King awaits to test new players.",
              "type": "exposition",
              "outcome": "The fight begins; Artie is initially intimidated by the boss's size.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Training Yard",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_start": "LOC_TRAINING_YARD",
              "location_end": "LOC_BOSS_ARENA",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie pushes open the heavy iron doors of the Boss Arena.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["heavy iron doors", "damp arena", "slime trails"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:7",
              "hands_off_to": "1:9",
              "transition_out_text": "The Slime King wobbles forward, its mass filling the room.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["wobbling mass", "green slime", "boss health bar"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "summary": "Artie fights the Slime King, dodging its slow attacks and swinging his sword into empty air.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "The Slime King takes massive damage from the Miss-Crit shockwaves.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01"],
              "threads": ["thread_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_start": "LOC_BOSS_ARENA",
              "location_end": "LOC_BOSS_ARENA",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie ducks under a glob of acidic goo and swings at a nearby pillar.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["acidic goo", "stone pillar", "air shockwave"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:8",
              "hands_off_to": "1:10",
              "transition_out_text": "Chunks of the Slime King fly in every direction as the invisible crit lands.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["flying slime", "invisible crit", "boss roar"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 10,
              "summary": "Artie lands a final massive Miss-Crit, exploding the Slime King and completing the tutorial.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "The tutorial boss is defeated via the 'Miss-Crit' exploit, granting passage to the world.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01"],
              "threads": ["thread_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Exit",
              "location_start": "LOC_BOSS_ARENA",
              "location_end": "LOC_TUTORIAL_EXIT",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie spins in a circle and strikes the floor five meters away from the boss.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["floor strike", "final explosion", "slime rain"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:9",
              "end_condition_echo": "The tutorial boss is defeated via the 'Miss-Crit' exploit, granting passage to the world."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 2,
      "title": "The Math of Murder",
      "goal": "Acquire the 'Running Shoes of the Coward' to enable the 'Hit & Run' portion of the build.",
      "chapter_role": "setup",
      "stakes_shift": "Transition from accidental survival to intentional exploitation of game mechanics.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Exiting the tutorial with a mountain of 'Missed' critical damage data.",
        "to_next": "A local dungeon offers the perfect testing ground for high-speed kiting."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 2,
        "tempo": "slow_burn",
        "expected_scene_count": 10
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Post-Game Analysis",
          "intent": "Analyze the tutorial loot and identify the need for specialized movement gear.",
          "end_condition": "Protagonist identifies the 'Running Shoes of the Coward' in a local shop's inventory.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie arrives in the Town Square and realizes he is incredibly slow compared to other players.",
              "type": "exposition",
              "outcome": "Artie decides he needs to increase his Agility or find speed-boosting gear.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Exit",
              "location_end_label": "Town Square",
              "location_start": "LOC_TUTORIAL_EXIT",
              "location_end": "LOC_TOWN_SQUARE",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie steps through the shimmering portal and into the bustling Town Square.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["shimmering portal", "cobblestone street", "crowd noise"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:2",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie watches a high-level rogue dash past him in a blur of motion.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["blur of motion", "wind gust", "player crowd"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Artie opens his inventory to check his tutorial rewards and finds a 'Discount Voucher'.",
              "type": "exposition",
              "outcome": "Artie identifies a potential way to afford high-tier gear early.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Town Square",
              "location_end_label": "Town Square",
              "location_start": "LOC_TOWN_SQUARE",
              "location_end": "LOC_TOWN_SQUARE",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie pulls up his inventory screen, which floats over the cobblestones.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["inventory screen", "discount voucher", "item icons"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:1",
              "hands_off_to": "2:3",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie scans the list of local shops for the most suspicious-looking name.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["shop list", "suspicious names", "map marker"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Artie browses a digital catalog at a local equipment hub and finds the 'Running Shoes of the Coward'.",
              "type": "exposition",
              "outcome": "Protagonist identifies the 'Running Shoes of the Coward' in a local shop's inventory.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Town Square",
              "location_end_label": "Equipment Hub",
              "location_start": "LOC_TOWN_SQUARE",
              "location_end": "LOC_EQUIPMENT_HUB",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie scrolls through the Equipment Hub's digital catalog with a flick of his finger.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["digital catalog", "scrolling list", "item descriptions"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:2",
              "hands_off_to": "2:4",
              "transition_out_text": "The description for the coward's shoes highlights a 50% speed boost when fleeing.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["speed boost", "item description", "coward shoes"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Protagonist identifies the 'Running Shoes of the Coward' in a local shop's inventory."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Scavenger's Grind",
          "intent": "Acquire enough currency through minor exploits to afford the gear.",
          "end_condition": "Protagonist purchases the 'Running Shoes of the Coward' from a sketchy vendor.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Artie tracks down Sketchy Sam in a back alley to negotiate for the shoes.",
              "type": "dialogue",
              "outcome": "Sketchy Sam demands a high price that Artie cannot yet afford.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01", "Vendor_01"],
              "introduces": ["Vendor_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Equipment Hub",
              "location_end_label": "Back Alley",
              "location_start": "LOC_EQUIPMENT_HUB",
              "location_end": "LOC_BACK_ALLEY",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie ducks into the shadows of the Back Alley where Sketchy Sam waits.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["alley shadows", "damp brick", "suspicious vendor"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:3",
              "hands_off_to": "2:5",
              "transition_out_text": "Sam leans against the wall, crossing his arms over his tattered coat.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["tattered coat", "leaning posture", "price demand"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Artie finds a low-stakes gambling game and uses his 99 Luck to win every round.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie accumulates a small fortune in gold coins.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01"],
              "threads": ["thread_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Back Alley",
              "location_end_label": "Gambling Den",
              "location_start": "LOC_BACK_ALLEY",
              "location_end": "LOC_GAMBLING_DEN",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie enters the Gambling Den, where the air is thick with smoke and desperation.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["thick smoke", "clinking coins", "dice rolls"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:4",
              "hands_off_to": "2:6",
              "transition_out_text": "The dealer stares in disbelief as Artie rolls three sixes for the tenth time.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["disbelieving dealer", "perfect rolls", "gold pile"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Artie returns to Sketchy Sam and uses his 'Discount Voucher' combined with a high Luck roll to haggle.",
              "type": "dialogue",
              "outcome": "Sam reluctantly agrees to a massive discount.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01", "Vendor_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Gambling Den",
              "location_end_label": "Back Alley",
              "location_start": "LOC_GAMBLING_DEN",
              "location_end": "LOC_BACK_ALLEY",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie tosses a heavy pouch of gold onto Sam's makeshift table.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["gold pouch", "makeshift table", "haggling grin"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:5",
              "hands_off_to": "2:7",
              "transition_out_text": "Sam sighs and pulls a pair of ragged-looking boots from a crate.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["ragged boots", "wooden crate", "resigned sigh"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "Artie finalizes the transaction and equips the shoes, feeling an immediate surge of speed.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Protagonist purchases the 'Running Shoes of the Coward' from a sketchy vendor.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01", "Vendor_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Back Alley",
              "location_end_label": "Back Alley",
              "location_start": "LOC_BACK_ALLEY",
              "location_end": "LOC_BACK_ALLEY",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie pulls on the Running Shoes of the Coward and laces them tight.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["shoe laces", "leather smell", "stat pop-up"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:6",
              "hands_off_to": "2:8",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie takes a tentative step and nearly slams into the opposite wall.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["sudden speed", "wall impact", "unsteady legs"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Protagonist purchases the 'Running Shoes of the Coward' from a sketchy vendor."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Calibration Run",
          "intent": "Test the new movement speed in conjunction with the luck exploit.",
          "end_condition": "Protagonist successfully kites a pack of field mobs without taking a hit.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "Artie heads to the outskirts of town to find a pack of mobs to test his new gear.",
              "type": "exposition",
              "outcome": "Artie locates a pack of Dire Rats in the fields.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Back Alley",
              "location_end_label": "Town Outskirts",
              "location_start": "LOC_BACK_ALLEY",
              "location_end": "LOC_TOWN_OUTSKIRTS",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie jogs toward the Town Outskirts, his feet barely touching the ground.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["grassy fields", "distant hills", "fast jogging"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:7",
              "hands_off_to": "2:9",
              "transition_out_text": "A cluster of red eyes glints from the tall grass ahead.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["red eyes", "tall grass", "dire rats"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "summary": "Artie engages the rats, running in circles while swinging his sword at nothing.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "The rats are decimated by the Miss-Crit shockwaves as Artie outruns them.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01"],
              "threads": ["thread_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Town Outskirts",
              "location_end_label": "Town Outskirts",
              "location_start": "LOC_TOWN_OUTSKIRTS",
              "location_end": "LOC_TOWN_OUTSKIRTS",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie breaks into a sprint, the wind whistling past his ears.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["whistling wind", "sprinting blur", "rat squeals"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:8",
              "hands_off_to": "2:10",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie swings his blade at a butterfly, causing a rat behind him to explode.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["butterfly target", "rat explosion", "shockwave ripple"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 10,
              "summary": "Artie finishes off the last of the pack, confirming the 'Hit & Run' build is viable.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Protagonist successfully kites a pack of field mobs without taking a hit.",
              "characters": ["Artie_01"],
              "location_start_label": "Town Outskirts",
              "location_end_label": "Town Outskirts",
              "location_start": "LOC_TOWN_OUTSKIRTS",
              "location_end": "LOC_TOWN_OUTSKIRTS",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie skids to a halt, kicking up a small cloud of dust.",
